Amy Got Back: Seth is shocked when Les brings back ex-pawn shop employee Amy. He later spots a mistake that could cost the store thousands of dollars. Is she to blame? (S7, ep 4)
Huddersfield 4: Join David Dickinson as more collectors try to sell their items to dealers. Will they strike a deal, or will they take a chance at auction instead? (S10, ep 70)
The Emperor of El Monte: Buyers Darrell, Brandon, Jarrod, Brandi and Ivy head to El Monte, California where they tackle the local competition head on. (S7, ep 9)
Deep In The Heart Of Upland: A surprise visitor from Texas shows up in time for a series of heated auctions in Upland, where a bad day for Ivy ends with a big bang. (S7, ep 5)
Daneurysm: Brandi struggles to keep Jarrod focused at abandoned locker auctions in Hemet. Meanwhile, Dan and Laura Dotson find themselves faced with a life or death crisis. (S7, ep 6)
The Education of Miss Profit: Darrell and Brandon discover the sweet taste of success, Mary looks for love and Jarrod and Brandi return to Moreno Valley. (S7, ep 7)
The Return Of The Mogul's Return: Even a fight with Laura can't keep Dave away from locker auctions in Montclair. Plus, how will Jarrod's hangover affect his bidding? (S7, ep 2)
The Man In Black Is Back... In Black: Dave Hester shocks the others when he returns to the auctions with vengeance. But can he stop them from buying up the best units? (S7, ep 1)
Sucked Up by a Tornado, Elevators Gone Wrong, Motorcycle vs. Flood and the Indian Ocean Tsunami of 200: A woman survives being sucked into a tornado. (S1, ep 7)
The Hindenburg Disaster, Pilot's Ejection Fail, When Trees Attack & Stuck In A Cave: A pilot activates his ejector seat at the last second during a rocky landing. (S1, ep 8)
Time Travel: Could the ability to travel through time be real? Experts unseal new evidence suggesting this phenomenon of science fiction might not be as far-fetched as it seems. (S1, ep 16)
Nazis Today: Many believe Hitler and key members of his inner circle survived the fall of Berlin. If so, where did they go? And did they flee with plans for revenge? (S1, ep 17)
Secret Alien Attack: Are governments secretly preparing for an alien attack? From death stars to satellites, experts explore the likelihood of an extra-terrestrial strike. (S1, ep 18)
Top Ten Secret Societies: Could elite groups of power players be plotting the fate of the world? Discover the plans and goals of the world's most secretive organisations. (S1, ep 19)
Extraordinarily out of the Ordinary: Face bizarre sights: a spinning island in Argentina, a desert triangle, Ethiopia's colourful pools and a giant figure in Australia's outback. (S3, ep 5)
Deep Blue: Dive into mystery: a sunken Italian city, a Keys underwater cemetery, a South Pacific yellow brick road and strange rocks off Australia. (S3, ep 6)
Perplexing Patterns: Explore a psychedelic swirl in the Utah wastelands, a bizarre configuration of circles in the Sahara and a remote polka-dot lake in Canada. (S3, ep 7)
The Templars: It's believed the Knights Templar owned vast swathes of land, commanded fleets, and lent money to kings. How do we separate the facts from the fiction? (S1, ep 1)
The Illuminati: While the Illuminati secret order was disbanded in 1785, many believe this elite group still hold the power and pull strings from behind closed doors. (S1, ep 2)
The Skull & Bones: Yale's Skull & Bones society is a pinnacle of the elite. But how do members get 'tapped' and is there any truth to the rumours surrounding this secret order? (S1, ep 3)
Most Powerful: From divine weapons, to formidable places, to sacred relics, these are the incredible stories of the world's most mighty marvels. (S2, ep 11)
Mysterious Structures: Discover a revolutionary War era ship hides under the streets of New York and a sprawling Roman villa is unearthed in the backyard of an English home. (S1, ep 1)
Hidden Treasures: Explore some of the most valuable treasures found in the most unlikely of ways. (S1, ep 2)
Hatfield Peverel (1566): Rylan and Alice reopen the 1566 Chelmsford Witch Trial, where Agnes Waterhouse, her daughter and sister face accusations of witchcraft and dark magic. (S1, ep 1)
The world's most haunted doll shows off its magic, a family in Oklahoma has a ghostly new roommate and a misty cryptid is caught on a security cam in the woods of Wisconsin. (S8, ep 5)
Two hikers take refuge from a storm in a haunted hut in Scotland and a California man's canine companion calls out from the other side. (S8, ep 9)
An Oregon woman doing some work on a remote cabin is spied on by a dark figure. Next, a man in Arkansas encounters something terrifying in the woods. (S8, ep 15)
An otherworldly figure walks across a Pennsylvania woman's front lawn and a haunted doll gets physical with its visitors in England. (S8, ep 12)
Hough: Janet Commins was killed in 1976. The wrong man went to prison while Stephen Hough escaped justice - until DNA revealed the truth decades later. (S5, ep 3)
In 1966, a class of Melbourne students spot a UFO and are told never to speak of the incident. A man's car dies in 2009 after he spots a cigar-shaped object in the New York sky. (S1, ep 5)
A teenager sees a mushroom-shaped object appear in the field while feeding his sheep in 1971. In 2000, police officers in Illinois chase a triangular UFO the size of a house. (S1, ep 6)
In 1980, soldiers encounter a luminous craft and dancing red lights in Suffolk. Witnesses report a metallic UFO hovering over water and crashing in Nova Scotia in 1967. (S1, ep 7)
A silent football-shaped object causes grave concern when it's spotted in Maine in 1975. In 1946, a UFO crashes and causes a deafening explosion as it crashes in northern Sweden. (S1, ep 8)
An Australian banana farmer spots a saucer-shaped UFO rising out of a swamp in 1966. That same year in Victoria, a man veers off the road while distracted by lights in the sky. (S1, ep 9)
A policeman hears a loud roar and sees an oval-shaped UFO in New Mexico in 1964. In 1994, a postal worker in Frankfurt spots an aura of light and a luminous object in the sky. (S1, ep 10)
Family Traitor: Seth makes a huge mistake that threatens to land the store in financial disaster. As he scrambles to correct it, Ashley spills the beans to Les. (S6, ep 3)
Millionaire Mayhem: Les works at breakneck pace to customise a $20,000 diamond ring. And when Ashley unjustifiably derails the sale, no-one blames Seth for hitting the roof. (S6, ep 4)
Urban Hillbilly: A customer hits the roof after Seth busts him for trying to flog fake goods. Later, panic grips the staff as a farmer lets an animal loose in the shop. (S6, ep 5)
Poachers: Les is furious to learn that dealers are poaching his customers. And things get worse when he informs a client that the bling on their diamond watch is bogus. (S6, ep 6)
Ashley's Breakdown: Ashley splashes out on a worthless roulette table, sparking one of the biggest fights in Gold family history. (S6, ep 7)
Ashley's Aftermath: Ashley returns to put Seth in his place. Meanwhile, a customer who has been robbed looks to sell her last remaining possession. (S6, ep 8)
That's the Way the Cookie Crumbles: Rick calls in a special guest to authenticate a Mick Foley T-shirt. Meanwhile, a seller walks in with an McDonald's cookie from the 1980s.
To Infinity and Be-Pawned!: The owner of a massive collection of Toy Story toys has high hopes for big money, but Corey's expert reveals some key details that are missing.
Old Rivals, New Wars: When the Taylor brothers show up, Brandon and Lori have a new civil war on their hands. But will they score big, or bust? (S1, ep 9)
Cash Dash: A smelly bin scares away most bidders, but it ends up being a great score. Plus, Brandon and Lori win a scary bin that may or may not have value. (S1, ep 10)
Medieval Melee: Buyers haggle over a locker filled with vintage surfing gear, while Brandon and Lori get a busted bin containing a case filled with a strange goo. (S1, ep 11)
Dirty Deeds, Dirtier Dealings: In San Diego, Brandon and Lori try to stick the Taylor brothers with a questionable vault - but it may just end up biting them in the rear. (S1, ep 12)

Griff Rhys Jones crosses one of the world's greatest mountain ranges. In France, he rides in a mountain chopper, goes whitewater rafting and chefs with a renowned cook. (Ep1)

p.t: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or...
p.d: ...List It: In Maidenhead, Nilesh and Raakhee are put off by their shut-off kitchen. Can Kirstie deliver a love-it layout, or will Phil's alternative abodes lure them to list it?
Lisa's Rival: Lisa is jealous of the new smart girl at school (guest star Winona Ryder) and conspires with Bart to wreck her entry to the Dioramarama competition.
Bart's Girlfriend: Bart falls for Reverend Lovejoy's rebellious daughter (guest star Meryl Streep).
Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in 'The Curse of the Flying Hellfish': Mr Burns wants to get his hands on the art he and Grampa stole from the Nazis in WWII.
Bart the Fink: Bart gets Krusty the Clown busted for tax evasion. Then Krusty disappears in a mysterious plane crash...
Abnormal Psychology: Frasier's excited to appear on a TV debate between psychiatrists - until he discovers that his opponent is a woman who he once dated: Dr Lilith Sternin.
House of Horrors with Formal Dining and Used Brick: Carla discovers her reasonably priced new house is haunted, so Cliff comes over to keep her company on her first night there.
Tan 'n' Wash: Norm invests in a combination tanning salon and launderette. But when he gets the Cheers gang involved in promoting the place, things begin to go wrong.
The Dog: Ray and Robert both want to keep a stray bulldog that Ray brings home. But it turns out that the canine isn't so stray after all...
Neighbors: Ray's neighbours demand a meeting at his house to discuss what to do about noisy Frank and interfering Marie. But Frank and Marie gatecrash the gathering.
Fascinatin' Debra: A psychotherapist interviews Debra for an article on the American family but finds the rest of the Barones more interesting than her.

Luck of the Draw: When a slick card shark teaches Matthew to gamble, he believes he's found an easy way to make money. It's up to Dr Mike and Sully to try to convince him otherwise.
Life and Death: Dr Mike clashes with Dorothy when she acts to protect her family from her friend's desperate son, who returns from war addicted to morphine.
The Abduction, Part 1: Blaming Mike for leading Custer's troops to them, renegade Native American Dog Soldiers abduct her; Sully vows to find her before she is killed.
The Abduction, Part 2: The adventures of Michaela Quinn, a doctor who lives in the post-Civil War frontier town of Colorado Springs.
The First Circle: A Denver banker invites the Ku Klux Klan to look for new members in Colorado Springs. The Klan are also seeking to force Robert E out of his home.
Come, Let Us Reason Together: Percival's father and Nellie's mother drive the expectant couple to distraction as they battle over which religion their unborn grandchild should be raised in.
The Nephews: Almanzo's brother Royal visits Walnut Grove and leaves his two sons in Almanzo and Laura's care while he and his wife enjoy a holiday.
Make a Joyful Noise: Joe Kagen moves to Sleepy Eye to assist at the School for the Blind. While there he begins to develop feelings for one of Mary's students.
Goodbye, Mrs Wilder: When Mrs Oleson demands Art and French be added to the school curriculum, Laura quits, leaving Mrs Oleson to cover the subjects herself.
Sylvia: Part 1: A new student, 15-year-old Sylvia Webb, catches the eye of the boys. But when she and Albert become friends, they soon become the victims of malicious gossip. Part 1 of 2.
Sylvia: Part 2: Mr Webb decides that because of the shame his daughter's ordeal has brought on him, they will move away from Walnut Grove. Part 2 of 2.
Strange Bedfellows: Charles' snoring is keeping Hawkeye and BJ awake at night but he refuses to discuss any suggestions. Colonel Potter discovers that his son-in-law has had an affair.
Say No More: General Collins refuses to accept responsibility for the war gaming which mortally wounded his son. Margaret develops laryngitis just before meeting her hero, Dr Steven Chesler.

A '60s hack-writer's work is given a new lease of life when he collaborates with William Shakespeare. Guest starring Burt Reynolds. S4, Ep18

Action mystery starring Dennis Quaid. A pair of crew members aboard a spaceship wake up with no knowledge of their mission or their identities. (2009)
Hammer horror with Christopher Lee. Count Dracula rises from the grave to unleash a plague on the world - but a descendant of the unflappable vampire hunter Van Helsing is hot on his trail. (1973)

p.t: UK Crime Files: Security Guard Killer
p.d: : Donal MacIntyre meets former Detective Chief Inspector Peter Hall to discover how Staffordshire Police solved Wendy Upton's murder at the hands of a security guard.

p.t: UK Crime Files: Murder: Buried Alive
p.d: : Stephanie Slater vanished while showing a house in Birmingham in 1992. Her kidnapper demanded £175,000, but the ransom drop failed, triggering an intense hunt to save her.

p.t: UK Crime Files: The Cliff Top Killer
p.d: : Geoffrey Wansell explores the story of John Cooper, who murdered four people on the Pembrokeshire coast. He was convicted decades later thanks to forensic evidence.

p.t: UK Crime Files: Saturday Night Strangler
p.d: : Jackie Malton examines the case of Joseph Kappen, who murdered three young women in South Wales in 1973. He was only identified through pioneering DNA techniques after his death.

p.t: UK Crime Files: Boarded Barn Murders
p.d: : Award-winning author Simon Toyne travels to Cheshire to investigate the opportunistic crimes that took place at a remote barn house in Congleton.

p.t: UK Crime Files: The Seaside Strangler
p.d: : Geoffrey Wansell revisits the case of Stephen Akinmurele, who was charged with murdering five people in Blackpool and the Isle of Man, before committing suicide prior to trial.

p.t: UK Crime Files: Murder Of The Secret ...
p.d: : Donal MacIntyre revisits the murder of a millionaire murdered in Hammersmith. With no friends or family, detectives used CCTV footage to track three suspects.

p.t: UK Crime Files: Blackpool Double Murder
p.d: : Geoffrey Wansell explores two eerily similar murders that take place ten years apart in Blackpool: two elderly women are killed. Could a cut clothesline unravel this cold case?

p.t: UK Crime Files: The Blackpool Poisoner
p.d: : Geoffrey Wansell explores how Louisa Merrifield poisoned elderly employer Sarah Ricketts at her Blackpool bungalow for inheritance and was hanged at Strangeways Prison.

Teleshopping with High Street TV
Teleshopping with High Street TV
The first host, Mrs Tee, charms her guests with her eccentric ways, at the four-star Gorse Meadow in the New Forest. But not everyone's room is up to scratch.
Alistair and Emma host at their four-star Castle Hill Guesthouse in sleepy Lynton, north Devon. The group activity requires a head for heights, and Mrs Tee proves hard to please.
The competition heads north to the three-star Vidella in Blackpool, run by fun-loving pranksters John and Neil, who have hatched a plan to pay back Alistair for hating their home town.
The group check in to the boutique Urban Beach B&B in Bournemouth, with its mod cons and deluxe bathrooms. And host Mark treats his guests to a speedboat ride along the Jurassic Coast.
The B&Bers meet for one last time to find out how much they've been paid and to thrash out their differences. There's trouble as Mrs Tee and Alistair and Emma clash over their scores.
Jasmine Harman helps Caroline and Gary with their dream of owning a Spanish holiday home. What will Valencia province's countryside and villages offer for their £150k?
Lee Juggurnauth heads to south-east Spain around the Costa Cálida to help Trevor and Mel find a dream holiday home. Will any of Lee's five fabulous options hit the spot?
Samantha and Sam are looking for their dream holiday home in Oliva, Spain, that will work for the whole family. Lee Juggurnauth shows them what their £85k can buy.
Rachel and Robin dream of buying a holiday home - which could later become their permanent home - in Alicante's Jalón Valley. Can Ben Hillman find their perfect place for £250k?
West Midlands. The first host, entrepreneur and social media star Kuda, takes his guests on a culinary adventure, with a Zimbabwean and world-influenced African à la carte menu. (Ep1/5)
West Midlands. The second host, construction recruitment consultant Rich, hopes to impress his guests with his Italian-themed night and food 'like mama used to make'. (Ep2/5)
West Midlands. Pharmacy technician Amy serves up an Asian extravaganza, on a night featuring a missing guest, some dodgy dancing and bum banter. (Ep3/5)
West Midlands. Make-up artist and self-professed 'glam goth' Sophie hosts, but can she stomach some very frank feedback about her food, or will she throw in the towel? (Ep4/5)
West Midlands. On the final night, club owner Phil treats his guests to a glitzy 'awards show'. Will his cooking skills, name-dropping and lip-sync battle impress them? (Ep5/5)
The first visit is to Harrogate, where management team Chris and Katie help to run the 64-bedroom White Hart Hotel. The extra charge for posh coffee at breakfast causes a stir.
The second visit is to Raouf and his friend Chrissie at the New Promenade Hotel in Blackpool. There's a teetering toilet seat, and Clarkey and Katie are turned off by muck on the taps.
Vicky welcomes her rivals to her aptly named terrace house, The Terrace, in Oxford. Two pairs of guests make some grim discoveries, including hairs and a pre-sucked sweet.
The final visit is to Robin and Liza's Georgian mansion, Tall John's House, in the Brecon Beacons. The guests gush over their new friendships, but Vicky doesn't seem to share the sentiment.
It's the final day of the competition and the B&Bers meet for the last time to settle some scores. There's anger as well as tears of joy when the winner is revealed.
Patients on the nightshift include a stabbing victim, an 86-year-old woman who's spent her life alone, and a former lawyer who's lost his wife, family and home to alcoholism.
The medical team, patients and their families face the meaning of life and death. One patient, 77-year-old John, faces a dangerous operation for a potentially deadly aneurysm.
The series with unprecedented access to Royal Melbourne Hospital's major trauma centre. Doctors treat a pregnant woman who's been badly injured in a high-speed car crash.
Dr Harrison fears that a tradesman who's been crushed under cement has brain injuries. Drs Cubitt and Alexander diagnose a man who's not as healthy as he seems.

A Crisis Of Faith. When Mary's faith is shaken by a tragedy in the community, Sheldon becomes an unlikely ally. S2, Ep3

The Inspiration Deprivation. Amy has a meltdown due to the pressure associated with winning a Nobel Prize. Raj and Howard try to relive the good old days. S12, Ep19
The Decision Reverberation. Raj is worried people won't take him seriously in his own field after publishing a paper that suggests he may have discovered alien life. S12, Ep20
The Plagiarism Schism. Kripke has proof that Dr. Pemberton plagiarized his thesis, and Sheldon and Amy aren't sure whether they should turn him in or not. S12, Ep21
The Maternal Conclusion. Leonard is surprised when Beverly is kind to him on a visit, until he finds out the real reason she's there. Denise and Stuart overstay their welcome. S12, Ep22
The Change Constant. Everything changes as Amy and Sheldon await big news. Howard and Bernadette leave their kids, while Leonard and Penny keep a secret. S12, Ep23
The Stockholm Syndrome. Bernadette and Howard leave their kids, Penny and Leonard try to keep a secret, Sheldon and Amy stick together, and Raj makes a new friend. S12, Ep24
Pilot. Brilliant physicists Leonard and Sheldon meet new neighbour Penny, who shows them that although they're smart, they know very little about real life. S1, Ep1
The Big Bran Hypothesis. Leonard volunteers to sign for a package to make a good impression on Penny, but things go terribly awry when he enlists Sheldon for help. S1, Ep2
The Fuzzy Boots Corollary. Leonard is depressed to learn that Penny is dating someone. Encouraged by his friends and fellow scientists, he asks a colleague out on a date. S1, Ep3
The Luminous Fish Effect. Sheldon gets fired and explores what life has to offer outside physics, leaving Leonard to take drastic action to snap his friend out of his funk. S1, Ep4
The Hamburger Postulate. Fearing he's wasting his time on Penny, Leonard makes a connection with Leslie. Meanwhile, Sheldon frets over a change to his hamburger routine. S1, Ep5
The Middle Earth Paradigm. Penny hosts a Halloween party, putting Leonard, Sheldon, Wolowitz and Koothrappali through a new test of their social skills. S1, Ep6
The Dumpling Paradox. When Wolowitz goes AWOL with one of her friends, Penny's recruited to fill in for him on the guys' Halo team. S1, Ep7
The Grasshopper Experiment. Raj's parents set him up on a blind date, and when he discovers he can talk to her, she shows interest in Sheldon. S1, Ep8
Alligator Arms. Robert has thousands of unique bumps on his arms that Dr. Lee has never seen. Stuart's cluster of back bumps disgusts his wife but thrills Dr. Lee. S4, Ep12

Do Iguanas Get Pimples Too? Dr. Lee faces off with iguana-wrangler Madison's head growths. Chanel suffers from painful cyst tunnels that leak and smell like the food she eats. S4, Ep14
Tumor Takeover. Matt has a skin condition that causes tumours to grow all over his body. Plus, Jennifer has a unicorn bump on her forehead. S1, Ep11
Sisters Lumpity Lump Lump. Amber has hundreds of tumours on her face. Cheri and Janice suffer from possibly matching lumps. Tatiana has an embarrassing bump on her butt cheek. S1, Ep12
Booby Trap. Danielle's size thirty-four, J-cup chest is blowing her budget sky high. Stephanie wants to show off the goods but her mother certainly does not. S13, Ep5
Nicole's Story. Weighing over 700-lbs, Nicole is on the verge of leaving her children motherless. She commits to the diet program, but crisis threatens to derail all her hopes. S5, Ep8
Please Love My Dress. Eccentric Marlene wants a feathered or black ball gown, but her parents prefer something traditional. Jessica loves every dress, but her family likes none. S13, Ep8
